component.name: WireGuide
component.summary: WireGuard VPN client with a graphical tunnel manager

description.p: WireGuide is a desktop client for WireGuard. Import or write tunnel configurations, connect with one click, and watch live transfer statistics from the main window or the system tray.

ul.li: Config editor with validation and autocomplete
Kill switch and DNS leak protection
Automatic connection rules based on Wi-Fi network
Connection history, route inspection and DNS leak test
